quantitative_threshold_rule: Signed commercial/betting license JSON verified on disk; zero unlicensed scraping of NFL.com
luck_or_leakage_failure_mode_blocked: Violating NFL.com Terms §§1.3 & 12 or relying on unverified third-party media scrapes without executable timestamps

quantitative_threshold_rule: Immutable feature_ts < bet_ts <= kickoff_ts - 5400s (for early models) or verified post-inactive window
luck_or_leakage_failure_mode_blocked: Hindsight leakage from retroactively updated injury statuses or post-kickoff snap counts bleeding into historical features

quantitative_threshold_rule: Strict expanding TimeSeriesSplit by NFL week; 2025+ Dynamic Kickoff (35-yd TB) & 10-min both-possess OT modeled explicitly
luck_or_leakage_failure_mode_blocked: In-sample overfitting and structural bias from pooling pre-2025 25-yd touchbacks or sudden-death walk-off OT margins

quantitative_threshold_rule: N >= 250 settled single bets or N >= 400 prop/parlay combos across >= 18 distinct NFL slate weeks
luck_or_leakage_failure_mode_blocked: Small-sample coin-flip heaters (e.g. going 14-4 over 2 NFL Sundays by pure binomial variance)

quantitative_threshold_rule: Exact integer-margin push mass on 3 7 6 10 14 and regular-season OT ties (`p_win + p_loss + p_push == 1`)
luck_or_leakage_failure_mode_blocked: Continuous Gaussian CDF errors that misvalue half-points on 3 and 7 by 150-350 bps of expected value

quantitative_threshold_rule: Holdout Brier(model) < Brier(closing_devig) AND LogLoss(model) < LogLoss(closing_devig) on identical games
luck_or_leakage_failure_mode_blocked: Uncalibrated high-variance longshot picking that temporarily profits from 1 lucky +600 parlay while losing probability accuracy

quantitative_threshold_rule: Mean same-line de-vigged CLV > 0 with NFL week-clustered t-statistic >= 2.50 (moved lines excluded/blanked)
luck_or_leakage_failure_mode_blocked: Post-snap NFL turnover luck (fumble bounce recoveries tipped interceptions missed kicks) masquerading as origination skill

quantitative_threshold_rule: 95% week-block bootstrap CI (`n_resamples >= 4000`) lower bound strictly > 0.0 on out-of-sample holdout
luck_or_leakage_failure_mode_blocked: Understated IID standard errors that ignore correlated Sunday wind/weather shocks or shared injury news across a slate

quantitative_threshold_rule: One-step Bonferroni and Holm step-down adjusted p < 0.05 across all M >= 10 candidate strategies & hyperparameter trials
luck_or_leakage_failure_mode_blocked: Data-snooping / p-hacking where testing 20 NFL trends yields 1 'significant' p=0.04 winner purely by chance

quantitative_threshold_rule: 4-way reconciliation of NFL.com injury report club depth tiers PS elevations and 47/48 active OL rules
luck_or_leakage_failure_mode_blocked: Blindly trusting club-site 'unofficial' writer depth charts or ignoring trade-deadline QB/defender arrivals

quantitative_threshold_rule: Positive-definite training-only paired residual correlation matrix (Cholesky pivot > 1e-12) + week-block CI; independence banned
luck_or_leakage_failure_mode_blocked: Catastrophic mispricing of negatively correlated combos or overpaying sportsbook SGP 'correlation taxes' on popular stacks

quantitative_threshold_rule: SHA-256 pre-kickoff observation digest config digest and reviewer signature bound before kickoff
luck_or_leakage_failure_mode_blocked: Retroactive deletion of losing bets selective backtest window cherry-picking or unverified self-asserted booleans
